trade_taken.structure: NO TRADE - the plan was watch-only at 0% size, conditional on two consecutive daily closes below 10.00. That trigger never armed.

components.claim: The $10 line decides everything: H&S neckline 10.07 and the dealer gamma-flip/put-wall agree
components.note: The $10 line did decide it - but upward. Only one close printed below 10.00 (9.93) in the entire 33-session window; the level held as support and price left it for good.

components.claim: The only bull lane - a 5-session ask-side sweep campaign - backtests just 37.5% (n=8) and the dark pool will not confirm it (large-tier buy_ratio 0.48)
components.note: The dark pool confirmed emphatically three weeks later: the 2026-07-09 mega block (54.6M sh / $644M, buy_ratio 1.000) and sustained large-tier buying (0.672 at review). Reading a 0.48 buy_ratio as refusal-to-confirm was premature, not wrong-in-principle.

components.claim: Flow points up, chart points down (DIVERGENT) -> no position until a level breaks
components.note: The decisive call of the plan. Flow was right and chart was wrong; standing down converted a would-be catastrophic short into a zero. Price went 10.27 -> 15.05 (+46.5%).

components.claim: H&S measured move targets ~6.94 with the 52w-low shelf at 9.20 en route
components.note: The head-and-shoulders never confirmed. Low of the window was 9.87/9.93 - the neckline was tested twice and defended both times. The pattern engine reports no H&S at review.

components.claim: A reclaim of $11 squeezes the 31.78% short float - stand down if it reclaims $11
components.note: The single most valuable line in the plan. PATH closed above 11.00 on 2026-07-01 and never looked back, running to 15.05. The kill-switch fired early and correctly.

attribution.note: The 0.48 large-tier buy_ratio was read as non-confirmation of the bull case; three weeks later the same lane produced a $644M ask-side block. The lane was not wrong - the snapshot was too early to conclude from.
31.78% short float was correctly flagged as the reason a short could not be sized - and it is what powered the +46.5% move.
The H&S read pointed down and never confirmed; the neckline held twice and became the base of the rally.
The $10 gamma-flip/put-wall was correctly identified as the pivot; it resolved as support rather than as the short trigger.
The 37.5% (n=8) sweep backtest justified refusing the long, but n=8 is too thin to have carried that weight.

lessons.lesson: When flow and chart point opposite ways, default to NEUTRAL/RANGE or a defined-risk fade only - never a full directional size. Log the divergence as the top reason_against.

A mid-range dark-pool large-tier buy_ratio (0.45-0.55) is 'not yet decided', not 'refuses to confirm'. Do not treat it as evidence for the bear side of a DIVERGENT read; hold it as unresolved and re-check before the next plan, because an institution mid-build prints near 0.50 until the day it does not.

proposed_rubric_edits.change: Distinguish 'disconfirming' from 'undecided' dark-pool evidence: a large-tier buy_ratio in [0.45, 0.55] should count as NEUTRAL for both sides rather than as non-confirmation of the bull case, and should trigger a re-check date rather than a conviction cut.
proposed_rubric_edits.rationale: PATH 2026-06-21 read a 0.48 large-tier buy_ratio as the dark pool refusing to confirm the bull lane. Eighteen calendar days later the same lane printed a $644M block at buy_ratio 1.000 and the name ran +46.5%. The 0.48 was an institution mid-build, not a refusal.

proposed_rubric_edits.change: Set a minimum-N floor on signal_backtest win rates used for Kelly p: below N=20, blend toward the conviction-bin fallback rather than adopting the empirical rate outright, and state the blend in deviation_reason.
proposed_rubric_edits.rationale: PATH 2026-06-21 used p=0.375 from n=8 to justify the bear tilt. n=8 carries a confidence interval spanning roughly 0.10-0.75 - it cannot distinguish a 37.5% edge from a 65% one.
